prompt_round2_result.diagnosis: Two different prompt framings could not get the roll below ~7.6%. A rolled-scroll edge is a strongly learned form in this model, and it renders at roughly 3x whatever thin proportion the guide specifies. This is a model bias rather than a prompt-detail gap, so further prompt wording is unlikely to fix it.

guide_to_output_ratio.computed_from: round-1 output median / guide target, per side
guide_to_output_ratio.implication: if the bias is roughly proportional, a guide band of about 0.8-0.9% would be needed to land the output near 2.8-3.0%. Untested — it is an extrapolation from one data point per side.

prompt_round2_result.practical_impact: LOW for the intended use. At 460 px wide the roll lands at ~36-40 px instead of ~13-14 px, so the 9-slice border becomes about (left=37, right=36) instead of (13, 14). The stretchable centre is still 460-73 = 387 px (84% of the width), so the sliced window renders correctly either way. The deviation is cosmetic, not structural.
